entries.dialogueText: We had strong support in the party and the Assembly, but I wanted a landslide victory in order to force a yes out of the Court. So I had invited Kesaro Kibener, leader of the National Front Party, to have a private chat about my proposal. He was supposed to be in my office 20 minutes ago.

entries.dialogueText: The final preparations for Sordland's new Constitution were nearly complete. Soon, it would be presented in the Grand National Assembly; a huge step for our administration. Then it would be on to the Supreme Court.

entries.title: Narrator: "I was halfway through my second cof..."
entries.dialogueText: I was halfway through my second coffee of the day when Kibener finally entered. He was wearing a brown suit with his party's pin neatly attached. After firmly shaking hands, he sat down.

entries.title: Narrator: "I knew I was on shaky ground with t..."
entries.dialogueText: I knew I was on shaky ground with the Assembly. I desperately needed more votes. So I had invited Kesaro Kibener, leader of the National Front Party, to have a private chat about my proposal. He was supposed to be in my office 20 minutes ago.

entries.dialogueText: "Likewise, President Rayne. We have much to discuss."

entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""I was stopped by the police on my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was stopped by the police on my way here. I seem to be subject to more and more such 'random' checks these days."

entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""I hope you don't mind the slight d..."

entries.dialogueText: "Some key figures in my party are also reporting obstructions from the state. It seems that your reforms aren't sitting well with certain members of the Old Guard."

entries.title: Narrator: "He pulled out a cigarette along wit..."

entries.title: Narrator: "He passed a cigarette to me and lit..."
entries.dialogueText: He passed a cigarette to me and lit it up.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a look at his lighter as he..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a look at his lighter as he put it down on the table. It was a regular Rippo, but the shape appeared to be malformed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Looking more closely, I could see a..."
entries.dialogueText: Looking more closely, I could see a large circular dent in the chrome plating.

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""It's a bullet mark.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's a bullet mark."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Believe it or not, this lighter is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Believe it or not, this lighter is the reason I'm alive today. I should be thankful that the damn assassin was Bludish. No wonder he was incompetent."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pulled on his collar to reveal t..."

entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Maybe I'll tell you the full story..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe I'll tell you the full story some other time. For now, let's talk about our collaboration. I know why you called me here."

entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""But before we get into the proposa..."
entries.dialogueText: "But before we get into the proposal, I'd like to discuss a few topics that I believe to be of higher priority."

entries.dialogueText: "The lighter took the first shot. The second one grazed me right here."

entries.dialogueText: "I may not be fond of President Smolak, but our joint operation with the Wehzeks was certainly successful in stamping out the BFF. I consider that a great success."

entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""The Bludish independence movement,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Bludish independence movement, for example. Not only do the separatists pose an existential risk to us, they also threaten our neighbors in Wehlen."
